fonts.note: System Helvetica stack verbatim from the real site; no webfont shipped. Mono used for eyebrows, step numbers, footer column headings and code.

radii.rule: Cards keep a >=1px --line border and radius <= 18px.

signatures.markDraw: hero <mark>::before draws the lime highlighter once: scaleY(0->1) from left bottom, inset 62% 0 8% 0, 700ms drawIn easing, 250ms delay
signatures.webSettle: cobweb one-shot settle (opt-in `settle` prop): sngw-web-settle 800ms pop easing, translate 0 -10px -> 0 2px -> -1px -> 0, rotate -5deg -> 2deg -> -1deg -> 0; keyframed on individual translate/rotate so mirrored cobwebs keep their inline flip
signatures.cardLift: .game:hover translateY(-4px) scale(1.03) on spring easing + box-shadow 6px 8px 0 var(--lime) + border-color var(--ink)
signatures.btnHover: solid buttons go --solid-hover with 0 0 0 3px var(--lime) ring; active translateY(1px); Halloween CTA lantern wiggles on hover/focus-visible (btn-pumpkin-wiggle 500ms)

hoverReplies.trigger: ancestor marked .sngw-anchor (hero, #games, see-all row, how); interaction-triggered, never idle
hoverReplies.ghostBoo: sngw-boo 600ms micro easing, one-shot swell to scale 1.08
hoverReplies.sparkleHover: sngw-anchor:hover replays twinkle/pop on a .sngw-sparkle--hover (a 14px hover-twinkle sparkle sits by the See-all button)

flightLoops.status: the ONE continuously-animated element in the kit — explicit user-ordered exception to the one-shot rule
flightLoops.composition: 4 ink silhouettes + 1 lime (bat d); sizes 16-30px; svg opacity 0.9
flightLoops.durationRange: 13-19s per bat, each with its own path shape, closed (0% == 100%) so loops are seamless
flightLoops.delays: negative on every bat — each starts mid-loop; there is no take-off moment on load
flightLoops.confinement: hero upper/side margins only: base spots top 6-23%, left 2.5-9.5%, right 3.5-7%; never crosses headline, lead, or CTA row
flightLoops.layer: absolute inset 0, z-index 2 (above backdrop, below nav z-30), pointer-events: none, aria-hidden

wingbeat.couples: loops only as part of the flight; dies with it under reduced motion

idleFloat.note: opt-in via idle prop on Bat/Ghost/Pumpkin; the only other infinite animation in the kit and NOT used on the homepage

rules: One-shot motion by default: entrance animations run once with both fill; nothing loops.
Hover replies are interaction-triggered, never idle animation; lifts stay <=3px and 150-200ms.
FlyingBats is the sole continuous animation — an explicit user-ordered exception; no second ambient loop may be added without the same order.
Every animation has a prefers-reduced-motion: reduce guard that disables it while keeping the artwork fully visible.
motion.reducedMotion: all decorative animation disabled: bats sit static at their base spots (flight + wingbeat animation: none), entrances shown fully drawn, hover replies off; global kill-switch in index.css clamps all durations to 0.01ms
motion.mobile: corner motifs hidden <=640px: hero cobwebs, hero bats, the whole .sngw-batfly layer, see-all pumpkin, see-all trail dots, see-all sparkle; <=760px App.css also hides hero web/bat/ghost, how web/corn, footer web/bat, card-bat, see-all trail

whimsy.namespace: .sngw- (src/components/startng-whimsy/), owned by the whimsy agent, never merged into global stylesheets
whimsy.colourDiscipline: local aliases read the page tokens with light-mode fallbacks (--sngw-ink/muted/lime/line/card); fill/stroke utilities only; the sole new hue is the scoped Halloween pumpkin orange
whimsy.icons: drawn-SVG-only: hand-authored inline paths, aria-hidden + focusable=false + pointer-events: none
whimsy.provenance: rebuild addition; the inherited real-site system (tokens, nav blur, mark gradient, card spring, sticker shadow) carries no whimsy code

halloween.window: Oct 28-31 (Halloween.jsx HALLOWEEN flag); the alternate Hallowhimsy motif set uses an Oct 25-31 window gated by <html data-halloween> with a data-halloween-disabled opt-out
halloween.flag: HALLOWEEN = true in src/components/startng-whimsy/Halloween.jsx (flip to false to remove the layer; PixelTrail doodles return beside the see-all button)
halloween.pumpkinScope: --sngw-pumpkin defined only on .sngw-pumpkin/.sngw-hw elements; consumed by .sngw-fill-pumpkin and --sngw-lantern (var(--sngw-pumpkin, var(--lime))); never on UI chrome, text, or page tokens
halloween.placement: hero corners (cobwebs top-left/top-right with settle, ghost bottom-right), one bat per featured card (card-bat), footer cobweb + lime bat, candy corn in how, lantern inside the CTA, pumpkin beside the see-all row

motion.rule: Hover-reply or one-shot only; no idle animation; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion

halloween.smallScreens: corner motifs + see-all pumpkin + see-all trail dots + .sngw-batfly hidden <=640px; small inline motifs remain
halloween.provenance: Addition by this rebuild; all non-pumpkin colour comes from the inherited page tokens
